bootstrap.aggregation: pooled MAE reconstructed from sampled daily absolute-error sums and sampled row counts

numerical_note: Observed XGBoost F3/F4 MAEs were converted from float32-derived NumPy scalars to Python float before relative-percentage arithmetic. This avoids negligible float32/float64 cross-check differences and does not alter predictions or the bootstrap procedure.
test_policy: All 15 horizon × feature-family configurations were selected using chronological validation MAE before any XGBoost test metric was inspected. Each frozen model was then refitted once on train + validation and evaluated on the held-out chronological test period.
